subject: Re: Next steps — evaluation kickoff and trial plan
messages:
From: Suzanne Park <suzanne.park@acme.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Rivera <carlos.rivera@acme.com>, tim.johnson@acme.com
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Next steps — evaluation kickoff and trial plan

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the call this morning — that was helpful to align on where we want to test Redwood for document QA and internal search use cases. Per our discussion, the two things we need to lock down next are:

- A kickoff meeting to walk through the evaluation plan and tech requirements (goal: schedule pilot infra and access).
- Agreement on success criteria and the initial prompt set / evals you want us to run.

Carlos (our infra lead) and Tim (product) should join the kickoff. We're available next week on Wed/Thu afternoons PST. I attached our initial security questionnaire (acme-security-reqs.pdf) — please confirm any gaps we should address before the kickoff.

Proposed success criteria (initial, from our side):
- F1: 85% relevance on the 50-sample prompt set
- Latency: median response < 700ms for 512-token requests
- Cost: estimated monthly token spend within the budget we discussed

Can you propose two times and a brief agenda? Looking to run the eval over a 2-3 week window after kickoff.

Thanks,
Suzanne Park
Head of Data Products, Acme Corp
@s.p

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Suzanne Park <suzanne.park@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 09:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Next steps — evaluation kickoff and trial plan

Hi Suzanne — great to meet you yesterday, and thanks for the clear next steps.

We can absolutely take this forward. Two proposed slots next week (PST):
- Wednesday Mar 3, 11:00–11:45am PST
- Thursday Mar 4, 2:00–2:45pm PST

Suggested kickoff agenda (30–45m):
1) Introductions + roles (5m)
2) Review trial plan & timeline (10m)
3) Success criteria & prompt set overview (10m)
4) Technical access & infra checklist (10m)
5) Next steps / owners (5m)

Marissa, I'm looping you in to own the eval plan doc and prompt set. Suzanne — can you confirm Carlos and Tim on whichever slot works? Also +1: please send any additional security items beyond the questionnaire you attached and we'll have our security team respond.

We typically share a short Redwood Eval Plan doc (draft) and the initial prompt set before the kickoff so everyone can review. I’ll attach the draft after Marissa gives the thumbs up.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.k@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 11:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Next steps — evaluation kickoff and trial plan

Thanks Neha — adding the draft eval plan and initial prompt set here.

Attachment: redwood-eval-plan.docx (draft) — includes:
- Proposed 2-week evaluation timeline
- Sample prompt set (50 prompts across doc QA, extractive Q&A, and semantic search)
- Data access and sandbox instructions (short-lived API keys, IP allowlist)
- Suggested success criteria + how we'll measure (automated eval harness + manual review)

I'll also add a short section with typical infra requirements (GPU vs CPU, throughput expectations) so Carlos has what he needs.

Neha — once Suzanne confirms a slot, I’ll share the invite with the doc and a short pre-read (prompt set + scoring rubric).

—Marissa
Solution Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Suzanne Park <suzanne.park@acme.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Rivera <carlos.rivera@acme.com>, tim.johnson@acme.com
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Next steps — evaluation kickoff and trial plan

Hi Neha — thanks for the options. Thursday Mar 4, 2:00–2:45pm PST works for our team — Carlos and Tim confirmed and will attend.

We appreciate you sharing the draft eval plan and prompt set. Two quick asks before the kickoff:
- Can you confirm whether the sandbox keys will allow testing on models with 4k context? (we have longer docs for some cases)
- Please include a short section in the invite for who owns data deletion after the eval window (we need that for compliance).

If you can send the calendar invite + pre-read today, we’ll accept and prep. Looking forward to the kickoff.

Thanks,
Suzanne
